book.name: LUKASI
book.title: NHALU GHWA MAHA PAGHUTYEKITWE NA LUKASI

content: Kubhelekwa kwa Yesu
Mu manjubha ghala Mutwa nkulu ghwa Akaaloma ywaakemitwe Agustino, kakikwilikiha bhandu bhoha bha utabhala ghwa nnima ghwa Lumi abhalangwe.
Mmalango aghwo ghwa bhandu ndo ghwa ulongohi pakabheghite Kulenio Mutwa ghwa nnima ghwa Silia.
Bhandu bhoha bhakighenda kubhalangwa kukitami pakabhelekwite.

Naywo Yosefu bhubho kakiyanda mwanja kuhuma ku kitami kya Nasaleti yiibheghite mu nnima ghwa Galilaya, kiyaha kakibhegha ghwa ubheleko ghwa Daudi, kakighenda kumbwani Betelehemu ku nnima ghwa Yudea, pakabhelekite mutwa Daudi
Kakighenda akwo kubhalangwa papamu na Malia nndala ywakanluhite, naywo Malia kakibha na ndumbo,
pa bhabheghite ku Betelehemu, linjubha lya Malia lya kupapa likihika.
Kakilela mwana nnume ghwa ulongohi na kakinhwika mapinda gha kilembwe, na kaking'onjeka mwana mulikungwa lya kualyegheha senga kiyaha yikibha ng'obhe ng'ebu kukitutubhi kya ahenja.
Ahakila na Andumitumi bha kunani kwa Chapanga
Munnima aghwo, pakibhegha ahakila anyama bha atamiteghe muihaka, paakihakila himati hyabhe hya anyama bha kuhuhwa pakilo.
Kamu nnole, lihoka lya Chapanga likiabwitukila, na ukulu ghwa Bambo ghukiang'alikiha mumbande hyoha, na bhakiyingilwa na lyogha muno nabho bhakiyoghopa,
peni lihoka lya Chapanga kakinng'ombela, “Nkotoke kuyoghopa! Kiyaha nnole, hika kubhaghombela nhalo ghwa maha ghwa kuayelela bhandu bhoha.
Lelo mukitami kya Daudi, kwakya mwenga kabhelekwa nlopohi ndo Kilisito Bambo!
Na ayi ndo naho kwa mwenga, mammona nonono kabhulungililwa mapinda gha king'enya na anng'onjeka mu likungwa lya kualyegheha senga.”
Kamu kukibha na lumati lukulu lwa hibhumbe bha kunani kwa Chapanga papamu na alyo lihoka lya Chapanga paakintika Chapanga paakilongela,

content.text: “Kubheghe na ukulu akwo kunani kwa Chapanga,
na uhihimilo ghubheghe munnima, kwa bhandu bha abhahaghulite.”

content: Abho Mahoka bha Chapanga Pabhabhukite kungughenda kunani kwa Chapanga bhala ahakila anyama bhakighombana, “Tughende Kubetelehemu tukaghubhone lilagho alyo, ghwakatughombilite Bambo.”
Ndo bhakiyumbatika kughenda ku Betelehemu na bhakiahikila Malia na Yosefu na yula nonono kaghonjehwa mu likungwa lya kualyegheha senga.
Paammonite yula nonono bhakialubhulila lila lilagho bhaaghombilitwe ghakya yula mwana.
Nabho bhoha bhaayihwite mihalo yaaghombilitwe na ahakila anyama bhakighakangacha,
peni Malia kakiyibhika malagho agho ghoha mumwoyo ghwake na kughahwachila muno.
Bhala ahakila mene bhakibhuya, kunu paakikweha na kuntikila Chapanga kwa mihalu hyoha ya ayiyihwite na kuyibhona, handa paaghombilitwe na andumitumi ghwa kunani ghwa Chapanga.
Yesu kangupeghwa Lihina
Mbole ya linjubha lya nhano na ndatu, ndo likibha linjubha lya kunndumula unyagho yula mwana, na bhakinkema Yesu, lihina lyakakambukite lihoka lya Chapanga, yikali na Malia kuyima ndumbo.
Yesu kangugheghwa ku Kitutubhi kya Chapanga
Palihikite linjubha lya kuliyogha, Malia na Yosefu tela na malaghilo gha Bambo ghakankamuhite Musa, Malia na Yosefu bhakighenda na mwana Kuyelusalemu ngati bhakannumike mwana kwa Chapanga.
Handa muyityekitwe mu Malaghilo gha Bambo, “Mwana nnume ywohele ywa ulongohi kaabhaghulwa kwakya Chapanga.”
Bhakighenda kutendekeha nyambi handa muyityekitwe mumalaghilo gha Bambo, ngunda abhili ebu ngunda bhana abhili.

Hino kakibhegha mundu yumo akwo ku Yelusalemu lihina lyake Simoni, mwene kakighatughila ghakaghapala Chapanga na kakibhegha ntundamila Chapanga, na kakibhegha pakighulindila kwa upalo nkulu ulopoho ghwa Akaisilaeli. Na Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kakibhegha pakinnyonjokeha mwoyo.
Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kakinlaghila kukita kaahwegha ng'obhe mbaka kammone Kilisito ywakabhaghulitwe na Bambo Chapanga.

Ndo, Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kakinlongoha Simoni kuyingila Mukitutubhi kya Chapanga. Malia na Yosefu paanng'eghite Yesu Mukitutubhi kya Chapanga kuntendela handa muyibheghite hitohe hya malaghilo gha Musa.
Ndo Simoni kakintola mwana mumabhoko ghake na kakinnonela kwakya Chapanga, pakilongela,

content.text: ndo ghunlekekehe nbhandwa ghwako kaghende kwa uhihimilo.
Kiyaha kwa mehu ghangu nummona Nlopohi.
Ghuunhaghulite kabheghe Nlopohi ghwa bhandu bha milima hyoha.
Mwene kaabhegha lubhwelu lwa kuang'aliha bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Ayahudi bhanmanye Chapanga,
na ukulu kwa bhandu bhako Isilaeli.”

content: Ndo Yosefu na Malia bhakikangacha mihalo yila yakalongilite Simoni kwa kya aywo mwana.

Ndo Simoni kakianonela na kakinng'ombela Malia maghwake yula mwana, “Mwana ayu katabhegha nhokolo ghwa kuahobheha bhandu, na kuahyuha bhandu atangalo Muakaaisilaeli, mwene katabhegha naho yakulemwa na bhandu atangalo.
Habhu mahwacho gha bhandu atangalo ghabhegha pa kindandabhanji, na kwa ghwenga lihingila handa kikechelo lyakuhoma mu mwoyo ghwako.”
Kakibhegha mbuye yumu nndala nng'ohi muno, lihina lyake Ana, biti Fanueli ywa likabila lya Asheli. Kakitolelwagha na kakitama na nnume ghwake ngungwa saba ndo nnume ghwake kakihwegha.

Mwene kakibha nndala nnekwa na kakibhegha na ngungwa mbinda mabhoko nane na ncheche. Aywo kakibhukagha ng'obhe Mkitutubhi kya Chapanga pakilo ebu pamuhi pakantumikila Chapanga, kunu pakilikunga na kuyupa.
Lisaa lila lila, Ana kakihika kakiyanda kuntika na kunnumba Chapanga na kakighomba mihalo ya aywo mwana, kwa bhandu bhoha bhaulindilite ukombohi ghwa Yelusalemu.
Kubhuya ku Nasaleti
Yosefu na Malia paayomolite kutenda mihalo hyoha ya malaghilo gha Bambo, bhakibhuya kukitami kyabhe kya Nasaleti akwo Galilaya.
Mwana yula kakikula na kuyonjokoheka makakala na pakimemekehwa mahala na ghumaha ghwa Chapanga ghukibhegha papamu naywo.
Nhongolo Yesu mu Kitutubhi kya Chapanga
Kila ngungwa Yosefu na Malia bhakighendagha Kuyelusalemu kukikubhukubhu kubhu kya Pasaka.
Yesu pakabheghite na ngungwa mbinda mabhoko yimo na ibhili bhakighenda ku chekwa handa muyibheghite hitohe hyabhe.
Paayomolite kikubhukubhu kubhu, Yosefu na Malia paabheghite mukubhuya ukaya, mwana ghwabhe Yesu kakihighala Kuyelusalemu. Peni abheli bhake bhakimanya ng'obhe.
Bhene bhakihwacha kukita kakibhegha mumwanja papamu na bhandu bhangi, bhakighenda mwanja ghwa linjubha lya nyima ndo bhakiyanda kumpalaha nkati ya alongo na aghanja bhabhe.
Kiyaha bhakimmona ng'obhe, ndo bhakibhuya ku Yelusalemu ngati anpalahe.
Linjubha lya ndatu bhakimmona mu Kitutubhi kya Chapanga kakitama pakati ya ahunda bha malaghilo pakiayihwa na kuakonyekeha makonyo.
Bhoha bhaannyihwite bhakikangacha mahala ghake na mayango ghakaayangite.
Yosefu na Malia paammonite Yesu bhakikangacha muno, maghwake kakinkonya, “Mwana ghwangu, bhuli ghungututenda naha? Nnole nenga na tate ghwako tungukupalaha kwa bhwaghalili ngulu.”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Yibhegha bhuli mungumbalaha? Mukimanya ng'obhe kukita yingungwiliha kutama Mukitutubhi kya tate ghwangu?”
Peni bhene bhakimanya ng'obhe fwambulo ya lila lilagho lyakaaghombilite.
Ndo kakighenda papamu na bhene mbaka Kunasaleti, naywo Yesu kakiayitikila kwa mihalo hyoha. Maghwake kakighendelela kukulungwa mumwoyo malagho agha ghoha.
Naywo Yesu kakikula mumahala na utandamaho, ghumaha ghwa Chapanga ghukibhegha naywo na kakianoghea bhandu bhoha.
